title: Re-stamp wholesale-overwrites submitted fraud_signals on any second run_create_checks
evidence:
trigger.gleam:
    Ok(inserted) -> {
      // ... AFTER the tx commits ...
      stamp_creation_fraud(config, app_uuid, data)
      Ok(Created(count: inserted))
    }

stamp_creation_fraud iterates every row returned (no status filter):
      list.each(refs, fn(ref) {
        stamp_one_creation_fraud(config, app_uuid, ref, refs, applicant)
      })

get_application_reference_contacts.sql:
FROM reference_call rc
WHERE rc.application_id = $1

stamp_creation_fraud_signals.sql (wholesale SET, no status guard):
UPDATE reference_call
SET fraud_signals = $2::jsonb,
    updated_at   = now()
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id::text;

complete_reference_call.sql (the other writer, already populated form_session):
    fraud_signals   = $3::jsonb,
detail: stamp_creation_fraud fires even when inserted==0 and re-stamps ALL rows (no status filter); the wholesale SET overwrites any submitted row's form_session to null and re-runs paid Twilio lookups. Reachable via manual-start then viewed (or vice versa).
recommended_fix: Skip the stamp pass when inserted==0, or filter get_application_reference_contacts / the UPDATE to rows whose fraud_signals IS NULL (or non-terminal rows), so submitted rows keep their form_session.
